split.method: chronological (train = first 70% by timestamp, then 10% val, last 20% test)
split.note: no random shuffle - this split is the honest one; shuffling could leak future behavior into the past.

decision_cost.why: FN cost (₹500) is set 10x FP cost (₹50): a missed chargeback is 10x more expensive than one extra manual review. The runtime cost engine uses the same constants.

headline: Fixed-threshold 0.5: P 100.0%, R 74.5%, F1 85.4% | Cost-optimal threshold 0.14: P 62.3% (95% CI 50.0%-73.4%), R 84.3% (CI 73.6%-93.0%) | Total decision cost reduced to ₹5,300 vs ₹6,500 at fixed 0.5.
